newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Labour says NZ First offer to Moore is a "gimmick".
newsitem.headline: Labour says NZ First offer to Moore is a "gimmick".

text.p: New Zealand Labour Party leader Helen Clark on Wednesday described as a "gimmick" an offer by Winston Peters to make former Labour boss Mike Moore trade minister in a New Zealand First government after the October 12 general election.
Radio New Zealand quoted Clark as saying Peters would be in no position to make the appointment because Labour would be leading the government.

Peters said the appointment would be part of his party's "Ministry of Talent" policy, under which it would appoint MPs to cabinet from outside the party and possibly from outside the ranks of any coalition partner.
